mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the risk-free rate, lowering the discount rate for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by rising FEDFUNDS and declining GDP growth), the Federal Reserve's policy rate hikes compress equity valuations by increasing the discount rate, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp and GDPC1 declines > 0.5% from prior quarter
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp and GDPC1 declines > 0.5% from prior quarter, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and strong corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher profits.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the payroll employment growth (PAYEMS) falls below 50,000 jobs per month for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth < 50,000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decline in residential construction (HOUST) signals stagflationary pressures that reduce real disposable income and housing demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises and HOUST declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock (defined by a sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL)), the resulting cost-push inflation and reduced output lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate margins are squeezed.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines > 1.0% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines > 1.0% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% MoM, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
